claims.text: The rider's position at the terminal is UNDECIDABLE on this record and must not be read against him. Every one of the 88 rider fixes in the trace reports horizontal accuracy between 45 m and 80 m - the signature of a handset indoors - so all of them fall outside the 25 m accuracy filter that POL-NS-04(c) shares with POL-NS-02, and such fixes 'count as evidence of neither presence nor absence'. POL-NS-04 says in terms that where the rider track is present but every fix in it is filtered out, limb (c) is undecidable and neutral, the artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(b), and the Judge must record that the test could not be run rather than inferring the rider was elsewhere. The raw rider-fix distances carried in derived.rider_presence (min 2039 m, mean 2101 m, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0) are computed on exactly those filtered fixes and therefore place the rider nowhere at all.

Nothing on this record shows the rider was ever told the driver was waiting, and the rider's account cannot be contradicted on this point. The system arrival notification at 23:13:11 and both driver messages (MSG-00202-002 at 23:14:03 and MSG-00202-003 at 23:19:31) all carry read_at null, and the trip was cancelled at 23:23:20 with none of them read. EV-CHAT-00202 is IMPAIRED - issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE, weight_multiplier 0.85 - and that impairment is disclosed here as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Its effect is that no finding that the rider ignored a locating message can be built on this artifact, and the unread flags corroborate rather than contradict the rider's account that he did not see anything until later.

The rider does not contest the dwell arithmetic or the amount, and says so rather than stretching either point. derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run runs 620 seconds from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, above the 480-second AIRPORT minimum in POL-NS-01(c); and the SGD 6.00 charged reconciles under the fee_schedule resolution rule as the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so no fare defect arises under POL-NS-08(d). The rider's case is therefore not, and is not put as, a shortfall case.

The one fact the rider's own track could have decided - whether the rider was at the pickup point - has no admissible evidence behind it: rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 and all 88 rider fixes are filtered out, which POL-NS-04 itself makes an impairment under POL-NS-08(b). Where the only evidence bearing on a fact in issue is impaired under POL-NS-08(b), POL-NS-08 forbids a ruling above PARTIAL_REFUND and directs escalation under POL-NS-09(e), and escalation is terminal: the SGD 6.00 is placed on hold rather than collected. The rider accepts that the driver's dwell is proved by the driver's own fixes; the submission is that the same trace simultaneously wipes out the only evidence of the rider's position, and that the charge should not be collected while that fact stands unresolved.

claims.text: Limb (a) of the baseline test is met on the trip_record: TRP-00202 carries an 'arrived' event at 2026-07-24T23:13:10+08:00, so the driver did mark arrival at this pickup point.

Limb (b) is met and POL-NS-02 is satisfied on its own terms: the GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for this pickup pin, with 63 qualifying in-radius fixes whose reported accuracy passes the 25 m filter, the first of them at 23:12:45 -- before the 23:13:10 arrival event. POL-NS-02 states that where qualifying in-radius fixes exist the clause is satisfied and the dispute turns on dwell duration under POL-NS-01(c), which is exactly this case. Because the driver held position INSIDE the arrival radius rather than outside it, the wrong-entrance clause POL-NS-03 is not engaged.

Limb (c) is met: the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run lasted 620 seconds, running from the first qualifying fix at 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, against the 480 second minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class. That is a surplus of 140 seconds, not a shortfall, and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires, not from the 'arrived' event.

Limb (d) is met: nothing in the trip_record shows a boarding event, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20 on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW -- fifteen seconds after the qualifying dwell ended at 23:23:05 and more than two minutes after the 480 second minimum elapsed on any computation of the clock. The code is one of the three the clause names (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT), and it is not DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE.

POL-NS-05 does not defeat the arrival marker: the 'arrived' event at 23:13:10 falls only 25 seconds after the in-radius run began at 23:12:45, so at the moment of the marker the driver was already stationary inside the geofence -- not more than 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h or above. There is no false-arrival correction to make and no limb (i) or (ii) refund follows.

POL-NS-06 is not engaged: the effective in-geofence dwell of 620 seconds exceeds the 480 second AIRPORT minimum, so there is no shortfall and no refund follows from that clause. The accumulation limb (i) is in any event unavailable, because EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (no payload, weight 0.0) and POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated -- but the driver has no need of it, since this is a single continuous in-geofence interval that already clears the minimum on its own.

POL-NS-04 cannot rescue the rider, because limb (a) fails on the face of the log: that limb requires a rider message during the waiting window whose content is locating or coordinating, and the chat_log for this trip contains no rider message at all. Disclosure of impairment: EV-CHAT-00202 is IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE. Its three entries are the system arrival notice at 23:13:11 and the driver's own two messages -- 23:14:02 'boss i'm at door 5 T3 arrival, black Toyota Altis SLA1234X' and 23:19:30 'boss? still waiting ah'. With limb (a) unmet, the clause does not apply regardless of the rider's account of a delayed flight, and the driver's two unanswered messages are consistent with the counterparty statement on file that he messaged twice with his plate number.

Rider presence is undecidable on this record and is neutral rather than adverse: all 88 rider fixes report 45 m to 80 m horizontal accuracy and are filtered out under the accuracy rule POL-NS-04(c) shares with POL-NS-02, leaving rider_qualifying_fix_count at 0. That neither satisfies nor fails limb (c) of POL-NS-04, and the artifact is down-weighted to that extent under POL-GEN-02. It does not help the rider either: because limb (a) already fails, POL-NS-04 is unavailable on either footing, and rider presence or absence is not the test once the dwell is met.

The amount charged is the amount the schedule prescribes, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged: fee_schedule.resolution_rule takes the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee -- SGD 6.00 for AIRPORT against SGD 4.00 for RYDE_X -- which is SGD 6.00, and fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is exactly SGD 6.00 on a ledger whose payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

The driver is entitled to compensation under POL-NS-07 because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it: 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee is SGD 4.80, which is the driver_compensation figure the fare evidence itself computes. The anti-farming check, run only on the two fields the clause names, does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 168 is about 0.006, far below 0.08. Disclosure of impairment: EV-DPROF-00202 is IMPAIRED, weight_multiplier 0.9, issue code SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH; the counters sit an order of magnitude below both thresholds so the discount changes nothing. No lifetime counter such as prior_no_show_flags is relied on, per POL-GEN-01.

No escalation trigger fires. The deciding fact -- the in-geofence dwell -- rests on EV-GPS-00202 at weight_multiplier 1.0, with 100 percent coverage, point_count 116, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so POL-NS-08(b) is not met; the trip_record arrived event reconciles with the trace well inside the 90 second tolerance of POL-NS-08(a); the chat_log holds exactly the 3 messages that trip_record.chat_message_count records and its longest inter-message gap (23:14:03 to 23:19:31) falls wholly after, and not across, the arrival marker, so POL-NS-08(c) is not met. EV-CHAT-00202 is down-weighted at 0.85 under POL-GEN-02 only and does not meet any limb of POL-NS-08, so POL-NS-09(e) does not apply. On the counters POL-NS-09(c) and (d) actually read, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the threshold of 3, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0.

The outcome the record produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd SGD 4.80, mirroring driver_compensation_sgd, while the SGD 6.00 fee stands as it presently is -- on this rider-filed dispute that is NO_ACTION on the fee, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 left untouched. POL-GEN-03 makes the ruling value DRIVER_COMPENSATION precisely because the case produces a payment to the driver, and states that amount_sgd carries the same figure in that instance; the rider's request to waive the charge is not supported.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver.

The SGD 6.00 no-show fee stands, and the platform pays the driver SGD 4.80 compensation.

The charge is valid. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold on this record. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 23:13:10. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius with 63 qualifying fixes at 25 m accuracy or better, the first at 23:12:45, before the arrived event, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied. (c) The driver held position continuously inside the geofence for 620 seconds (23:12:45 to 23:23:05), above the 480-second AIRPORT minimum, measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires. (d) There is no boarding event, and the driver terminated the trip at 23:23:20 on RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed — one of the three codes the clause names, and not DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE.

No clause displaces the charge. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not engaged: the driver held position inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) requires as limb (a) that the rider sent a locating or coordinating message in the chat log; the log contains no rider message at all, so the clause is unavailable on either footing, and rider presence is not its test. POL-NS-05 (false arrival) is not engaged: at the 23:13:10 marker the driver was stationary inside the geofence, 25 seconds after the run began — not more than 300 m from the pin and not moving at 15 km/h or above — so there is nothing to correct and no limb (i) or (ii) refund follows. POL-NS-06 (shortfall) is not engaged: 620 seconds exceeds the 480-second minimum by 140 seconds. Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 governs.

The amount is right. Under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the fee is the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), which is SGD 6.00; the ledger charges exactly SGD 6.00 with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. Compensation is 80 per cent of SGD 6.00 = SGD 4.80, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below 4, and 1 over 168 completed trips is about 0.006, far below 0.08. The ruling value is therefore DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 4.80; on the fee itself the charge stands (NO_ACTION), and the rider's request to waive it is not supported.

The rider's presence is undecidable, and I do not hold that against him. All 88 rider fixes report 45 m to 80 m horizontal accuracy — what a handset inside a terminal reports — and are filtered out under the 25 m rule that POL-NS-04(c) shares with POL-NS-02, leaving rider_qualifying_fix_count at 0. Rider presence is therefore undecidable and neutral: the test could not be run, and the distances carried in derived.rider_presence, computed on those filtered fixes, place the rider nowhere at all. The rider's account that he did not see the messages until later is consistent with the chat log, in which the system arrival notice and both driver messages all carry read_at null. But rider presence is not the deciding fact: POL-NS-01 charges the fee on the driver's arrival and dwell, and POL-NS-06 states the outcome holds whether or not the rider was present.

The rider's escalation argument is rejected. The deciding fact — the qualifying in-geofence dwell — is carried by the GPS trace at weight 1.0 (100 per cent coverage, 116 fixes, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0) and the trip record at 1.0. POL-NS-08(b) is not met on those artifacts, so POL-NS-09(e) does not fire: no deciding fact rests solely on evidence impaired under limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08. I accept the rider fixes are undecidable, but that does not impair the deciding fact and does not bar the ruling. No other POL-NS-09 trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (the 23:13:10 arrived event and the 620-second dwell reconcile well inside the 90-second tolerance of POL-NS-08(a)); rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below 3; and the anti-farming check does not trip.

Impairments named, as POL-GEN-02 requires. EV-CHAT-00202 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE): it explains why the rider saw nothing, but it does not carry the dwell and does not decide the case, so the discount does not change the result. EV-DPROF-00202 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.9 (issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH): its anti-farming counters sit an order of magnitude below the POL-NS-07 thresholds, so the discount changes nothing. EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and carries no fact; no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed because the dwell is a single continuous interval that already clears the minimum. Confidence is 0.9: the dwell rests on the GPS trace and trip record at weight 1.0, and taking the lowest weight among the artifacts the compensation ruling relies on — the driver profile at 0.9 — keeps it above the 0.70 escalation floor. Under POL-GEN-01 the driver's prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter and context only, and the driver correctly did not rely on it; I have not used it, nor the rider's rating, account age or trip counts, all of which are context only.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: this is about the SGD 6.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-00202 (Changi T3, AIRPORT zone class). The fee turns on the driver's arrival and waiting time, and that is proved.

To the rider. The charge does not depend on whether the delay was your fault or whether you read any message. The record shows the driver entered the 150 m AIRPORT pickup geofence at 23:12:45 and held position there continuously for 620 seconds, to 23:23:05 — above the 480-second minimum for an airport pickup — and then cancelled at 23:23:20 on reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event. That satisfies POL-NS-01 on all four limbs. The arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05: at the 23:13:10 marker the driver was stationary inside the geofence, only 25 seconds after the run began, so there is no recomputed clock and no refund. POL-NS-03 does not apply either, because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it.

I accept your central point about your own position. All 88 fixes in the rider track report 45–80 m accuracy and are ignored under the shared 25 m filter, so your location cannot be established one way or the other. POL-NS-04 makes that undecidable and neutral — it is not evidence that you were absent — and I have not read it against you. But it does not decide this case. POL-NS-01 does not require proof that you were absent, and POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you because its limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message from you during the wait, and you sent none. The chat entries (the system 'driver has arrived' notice at 23:13:11 and the driver's messages at 23:14:02 and 23:19:30) all carry read_at null, which is consistent with your account that you saw nothing until later; the driver's account of two messages with his plate number matches the log. None of this moves the fee, because the charge does not depend on whether the messages were read.

I refuse the escalation you sought. POL-NS-09(e) applies only where the ONLY evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d). The deciding fact here — the driver's in-geofence wait — is carried by EV-GPS-00202 at weight 1.0 (100% coverage, 116 fixes, no gaps, max gap 0 s) and by EV-TRIP-00202 at weight 1.0, with no clock skew (the 23:13:10 arrival event and the 23:23:20 termination both reconcile with the trace within seconds) and no chat defect. POL-NS-08(a)–(d) is not met. Your position is not the deciding fact, so its undecidability cannot trigger escalation. The one fact your track might have settled simply is not an element of the charge.

To the driver. You are entitled to compensation. The fee is correctly computed: the resolution rule takes the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), i.e. SGD 6.00, which is exactly what the ledger charges, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 pays you 80% of SGD 6.00 = SGD 4.80, the platform retaining the residual 20%. The anti-farming check, run only on the two fields the clause names (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the threshold of 4; 1 ÷ 168 completed trips ≈ 0.006, below 0.08), does not trip. Because a payment to the driver is the outcome, the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same SGD 4.80 (POL-GEN-03); the SGD 6.00 fee stands as charged.

Impairment and confidence. EV-CHAT-00202 is impaired (weight 0.85; issue UNREAD_MESSAGE); it is down-weighted under POL-GEN-02 only, and it does not meet POL-NS-08(c), since it holds exactly the 3 messages the trip record counts and its longest gap (23:14:03–23:19:31) falls after, not across, the arrival marker. EV-DPROF-00202 is impaired (weight 0.9; issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH); it carries the anti-farming counters, and the discount changes nothing because those counters sit far below both thresholds. EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) and can carry no fact; the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation it would have supported was neither available nor needed, because a single continuous 620-second interval already clears the minimum. No context-only profile field was used as a ground: prior_no_show_flags appears only as a field expressly not relied on (POL-GEN-01). My confidence is capped at 0.9, the lowest weight among the artifacts carrying the facts this ruling rests on — the anti-farming clearance from the driver profile at 0.9, and the wait and arrival from the GPS trace and trip record at 1.0. That is above the 0.70 escalation floor, so no escalation arises on that ground either.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute is decided on the record.

The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is properly chargeable and stays as it is. For the charge to stand, the driver must have arrived at your pickup point and held position for the AIRPORT minimum of 480 seconds. The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' marker at 23:13:10, and the GPS trace puts 63 fixes inside the 150 m Terminal 3 arrival radius, the first at 23:12:45 - before the marker - with unbroken coverage (116 fixes, no gaps, longest run 620 seconds, from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05). Measured from that first qualifying fix, as the clause requires, the dwell is 620 seconds against the 480-second minimum: a 140-second surplus, not a shortfall. The trip was then cancelled by the driver at 23:23:20 on RIDER_NO_SHOW. All four conditions of the baseline test are met, and none of the wrong-entrance (POL-NS-03), unanswered-contact (POL-NS-04), false-arrival (POL-NS-05) or shortfall (POL-NS-06) clauses displaces them. The amount is also correct: the resolution rule takes the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so SGD 6.00, and the fare breakdown reconciles exactly, so there is no fare defect.

The rider's argument for escalation is rejected. The rider's own position at the terminal cannot be established from the trace - all 88 rider fixes report 45-80 m accuracy and are filtered out under the 25 m rule - but that is undecidable and neutral, not adverse, and rider presence is not one of the conditions the fee depends on. The deciding fact, the driver's in-geofence dwell, rests on the driver's fixes in EV-GPS-00202 (unbroken, full weight) and on EV-TRIP-00202 (full weight); it is not carried by impaired evidence. The impaired-sole-evidence escalation condition therefore does not fire, and no other escalation trigger is met (confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other, no repeat-counterparty pattern, the anti-farming check does not trip). The rider's account that he did not see the messages is consistent with the record - the system notice and both driver messages all carry read_at null - but the contact clause fails independently because the log contains no rider message at all, and a rider's non-response does not by itself defeat a properly established dwell.

Driver compensation: because the fee is properly chargeable, the driver is paid 80 percent of SGD 6.00, which is SGD 4.80. The anti-farming check reads only the two trailing-30-day counters; with 1 termination across 168 completed trips (ratio about 0.006) it is far below both thresholds, so compensation is paid. Two artifacts below full weight are named for completeness: EV-DPROF-00202 (weight 0.9, SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH), which carries the anti-farming limb - its counters sit an order of magnitude below the thresholds, so the finding survives the discount and sets the confidence cap of 0.9; and EV-CHAT-00202 (weight 0.85, UNREAD_MESSAGE), which does not carry the deciding fact. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) and carries no fact; it would matter only to a dwell-accumulation argument this single continuous 620-second interval does not need.

Outcome: the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The SGD 6.00 charge stands (no refund to the rider), and SGD 4.80 is paid to the driver; per the ruling vocabulary, amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at SGD 4.80, being the amount this ruling moves. No clause produces a referral.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 6.00 no-show charge stands and the driver is paid SGD 4.80. Here is my reasoning on every point either side raised.

WHY THE CHARGE IS VALID. POL-NS-01 requires four conditions, and all four hold. (a) The trip record carries an 'arrived' event at 23:13:10. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius before that event: 63 fixes pass the 25 m accuracy filter and the first qualifying in-radius fix is at 23:12:45, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied on its own terms. (c) The driver's continuous in-geofence hold runs 620 seconds, 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires, against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum a surplus of 140 seconds. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20 on RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes the clause names, with no boarding event. The SGD 6.00 is the correct figure: under fee_schedule.resolution_rule it is the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

NO CLAUSE DISPLACES IT. POL-NS-03 is not engaged: the driver held position inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the arrival marker at 23:13:10 came only 25 seconds after the in-radius run began, so the driver was already stationary inside the geofence, not over 300 m away and not moving at 15 km/h or more; there is no false marker and no correction to make. POL-NS-06 is not engaged: there is no dwell shortfall, so nothing is refunded. POL-NS-04 does not apply: its limb (a) requires the chat log to show a rider message that is locating or coordinating, and the log contains no rider message at all, so the clause fails at the threshold regardless of the rider's account of a delayed flight.

THE RIDER'S ARGUMENTS. I accept that the rider's own position is undecidable on this record, and I record that the test could not be run rather than inferring the rider was elsewhere. All 88 rider fixes report 45 m to 80 m horizontal accuracy and are filtered out under the 25 m rule shared by POL-NS-04(c) and POL-NS-02, leaving rider_qualifying_fix_count at 0; under POL-NS-04 that is neutral rather than adverse. I also accept that nothing shows the rider read any message: the system notice at 23:13:11 and both driver messages (23:14:02 and 23:19:30) carry read_at null, which corroborates his account that he saw nothing until later. But neither point changes the outcome. POL-NS-01 does not depend on the rider's presence, and POL-NS-06 refunds only on a dwell shortfall, and there is none. The rider's request that the charge be waived because the delay was not his fault is therefore not supported by the evidence.

THE ESCALATION ARGUMENT IS DECLINED. I do not escalate under POL-NS-09(e). That limb fires only where the SOLE evidence for the DECIDING fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d). The deciding fact here is the driver's qualifying arrival and dwell, and that is carried by the GPS driver track (100 per cent coverage, 116 fixes, max gap 0.0 s, so no limb of POL-NS-08 is met) together with the trip record. The rider-track impairment goes to rider presence, which is not the deciding fact. No other trigger fires: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the same-party counters are zero; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip.

CONFIDENCE AND IMPAIRED ARTIFACTS. The ruling rests on the GPS trace and trip record (weight 1.0 each) for the qualifying dwell, the fare breakdown (1.0) for the amount, and the driver profile (weight 0.9, issue SCHEMA_VERSION_MISMATCH) for the anti-farming gate on compensation. The driver profile's counters are 1 no-show termination across 168 completed trips in 30 days, far below both POL-NS-07 thresholds (4, and 0.08), so the discount changes nothing, but it caps my confidence at 0.9. The chat log is impaired at weight 0.85 (issue UNREAD_MESSAGE); it does not carry the deciding fact and, so far as it shows the driver waiting at the door, it restates what the instruments already show, so it does not lower the cap. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0): its absence makes the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation limb unavailable and cannot be asserted to exonerate anyone, but this single continuous interval clears the minimum on its own and does not need it. The driver's counterparty statement (waited over ten minutes, messaged twice with his plate number) is consistent with the record; it carries no weight multiplier and so enters neither the floor nor the cap.

OUTCOME FOR THE FILING PARTY AND THE DRIVER. On this rider-filed dispute the SGD 6.00 charge stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The driver is compensated at 80 per cent of the SGD 6.00 fee, which is SGD 4.80, the platform retaining the SGD 1.20 residual; because the case produces that payment, the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same SGD 4.80 figure, per POL-GEN-03. No referral is produced by any clause.

ledger.claim: The rider's position at the terminal is UNDECIDABLE on this record and must not be read against him. Every one of the 88 rider fixes in the trace reports horizontal accuracy between 45 m and 80 m - the signature of a handset indoors - so all of them fall outside the 25 m accuracy filter that POL-NS-04(c) shares with POL-NS-02, and such fixes 'count as evidence of neither presence nor absence'. POL-NS-04 says in terms that where the rider track is present but every fix in it is filtered out, limb (c) is undecidable and neutral, the artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08(b), and the Judge must record that the test could not be run rather than inferring the rider was elsewhere. The raw rider-fix distances carried in derived.rider_presence (min 2039 m, mean 2101 m, rider_qualifying_fix_count 0) are computed on exactly those filtered fixes and therefore place the rider nowhere at all.

Nothing on this record shows the rider was ever told the driver was waiting, and the rider's account cannot be contradicted on this point. The system arrival notification at 23:13:11 and both driver messages (MSG-00202-002 at 23:14:03 and MSG-00202-003 at 23:19:31) all carry read_at null, and the trip was cancelled at 23:23:20 with none of them read. EV-CHAT-00202 is IMPAIRED - issue code UNREAD_MESSAGE, weight_multiplier 0.85 - and that impairment is disclosed here as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Its effect is that no finding that the rider ignored a locating message can be built on this artifact, and the unread flags corroborate rather than contradict the rider's account that he did not see anything until later.

The rider does not contest the dwell arithmetic or the amount, and says so rather than stretching either point. derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run runs 620 seconds from 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, above the 480-second AIRPORT minimum in POL-NS-01(c); and the SGD 6.00 charged reconciles under the fee_schedule resolution rule as the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so no fare defect arises under POL-NS-08(d). The rider's case is therefore not, and is not put as, a shortfall case.

The one fact the rider's own track could have decided - whether the rider was at the pickup point - has no admissible evidence behind it: rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0 and all 88 rider fixes are filtered out, which POL-NS-04 itself makes an impairment under POL-NS-08(b). Where the only evidence bearing on a fact in issue is impaired under POL-NS-08(b), POL-NS-08 forbids a ruling above PARTIAL_REFUND and directs escalation under POL-NS-09(e), and escalation is terminal: the SGD 6.00 is placed on hold rather than collected. The rider accepts that the driver's dwell is proved by the driver's own fixes; the submission is that the same trace simultaneously wipes out the only evidence of the rider's position, and that the charge should not be collected while that fact stands unresolved.
Limb (a) of the baseline test is met on the trip_record: TRP-00202 carries an 'arrived' event at 2026-07-24T23:13:10+08:00, so the driver did mark arrival at this pickup point.

Limb (b) is met and POL-NS-02 is satisfied on its own terms: the GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for this pickup pin, with 63 qualifying in-radius fixes whose reported accuracy passes the 25 m filter, the first of them at 23:12:45 -- before the 23:13:10 arrival event. POL-NS-02 states that where qualifying in-radius fixes exist the clause is satisfied and the dispute turns on dwell duration under POL-NS-01(c), which is exactly this case. Because the driver held position INSIDE the arrival radius rather than outside it, the wrong-entrance clause POL-NS-03 is not engaged.

Limb (c) is met: the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run lasted 620 seconds, running from the first qualifying fix at 23:12:45 to 23:23:05, against the 480 second minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class. That is a surplus of 140 seconds, not a shortfall, and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires, not from the 'arrived' event.

Limb (d) is met: nothing in the trip_record shows a boarding event, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 23:23:20 on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW -- fifteen seconds after the qualifying dwell ended at 23:23:05 and more than two minutes after the 480 second minimum elapsed on any computation of the clock. The code is one of the three the clause names (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT), and it is not DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE.

POL-NS-05 does not defeat the arrival marker: the 'arrived' event at 23:13:10 falls only 25 seconds after the in-radius run began at 23:12:45, so at the moment of the marker the driver was already stationary inside the geofence -- not more than 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h or above. There is no false-arrival correction to make and no limb (i) or (ii) refund follows.

POL-NS-06 is not engaged: the effective in-geofence dwell of 620 seconds exceeds the 480 second AIRPORT minimum, so there is no shortfall and no refund follows from that clause. The accumulation limb (i) is in any event unavailable, because EV-ADVIS-00202-01 is MISSING (no payload, weight 0.0) and POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated -- but the driver has no need of it, since this is a single continuous in-geofence interval that already clears the minimum on its own.

Its three entries are the system arrival notice at 23:13:11 and the driver's own two messages -- 23:14:02 'boss i'm at door 5 T3 arrival, black Toyota Altis SLA1234X' and 23:19:30 'boss? still waiting ah'.
